description: Ethereum node state from our own Reth (execution) + Lighthouse (consensus): sync state, height/head slot, peers, clients, and — while the node is still being provisioned — an explicit provisioning status. When to use: whether the ETH node is up/synced, or what stage its provisioning/sync is at. Do not use: for PoW hashrate questions — Ethereum is proof-of-stake (see pow_network_mining_intel).
name: eth_node_status
